page.layout: One column of text: a centred title in three lines at the head, then a list of names, each followed by a rule. Lines at the foot, bottom right: the start of a heading in capitals.; One column of text at left, cut off in this part; a vertical rule and a column of years 1623 to 1644 to its right, each year on its own line; running head at top right; page number at top right.

main_text.head: Series eorum qui in collegio Ammirastelodami nomine provinciæ per vices e& urbe ederunt.

page.notes: Heading lines are as printed: "stelodami" is read as "stelodami". The first two names are read with some doubt in the spelling "Morits". The partly visible word at the foot right is taken as the start of a capitalised heading and may continue beyond the edge of this part. The years 1623 to 1644 are set in a column beside the rule, one per line, as printed. "2637" is printed that way and may be a misprint for 1637.
